title: Contextual Decision Making: Predictive or Generative
abstract: arXiv:2610.32584v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Contextual decision making uses observed covariates to guide decisions under uncertainty. Two natural approaches are predict-then-optimize (PtO), which learns the conditional expected objective, and generate-then-optimize (GtO), which learns conditional uncertainty and optimizes using generated scenarios. We study when each approach is preferable by examining how the choice of learning target affects statistical accuracy and optimization tractability. Although PtO learns a narrower target, our regret bounds show how differences in smoothness can offset GtO's additional dimensional burden. Exploiting smoothness also raises an optimization tradeoff: within the class of nonnegative-weight PtO methods studied, a lower bound limits the gains from additional smoothness, while more flexible methods may introduce signed weights and lose the guarantee of preserving convexity. translated_title: 情境决策：预测式还是生成式
translated_abstract: 情境决策利用观测到的协变量在不确定性条件下指导决策。两种自然的方法是“先预测后优化”，它学习条件期望目标；以及“先生成后优化”，它学习条件不确定性并利用生成的场景进行优化。我们通过考察学习目标的选择如何影响统计精度与优化的可解性，来研究何时哪种方法更优。尽管PtO学习的目标范围更窄，我们的遗憾界表明，平滑性方面的差异可以抵消GtO所承担的额外维度负担。利用平滑性同时引发了一个优化上的权衡：在本文所研究的非负权重PtO方法类中，一个下界限制了额外平滑性所能带来的收益；而更灵活的方法可能引入带符号的权重，从而失去保持凸性的保证。GtO能够保持逐场景凸性，但需要学习更丰富（的不确定性模型）。
tldr: 该论文从统计精度与优化可解性两个角度系统比较了先预测后优化与先生成后优化两种情境决策范式，证明了平滑性差异可以抵消生成式方法的维度负担，并揭示了凸性保持与学习复杂度之间的基本权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically compares predict-then-optimize and generate-then-optimize approaches for contextual decision making from statistical and optimization perspectives, showing that smoothness differences can offset GtO's dimensional burden while revealing a fundamental tradeoff between convexity preservation and learning complexity.
